title: Compact Mission Control + create tasks from UI
description: Sync ONLY src/components/MissionControlView.tsx from GitHub main into the AI Studio workspace. This reviewed version removes the oversized timing/progress cards, keeps time/progress as one compact metadata line in the hero, hides repetitive idle heartbeat entries from recent activity, simplifies labels, and turns the bottom form into a real task creator: selecting ChatGPT or AI Studio creates an actual Bridge task assigned to that agent; selecting All only sends a team note. Do not redesign or expand the UI. Do not modify package.json, server.ts, database files, or deployment-specific startup code. After syncing, run npm run lint and npm run build, restart Preview, verify /health is ok, and visually confirm the hero is compact on mobile. Do not publish yet; report result through Studio Relay.
